answer: An identity earns weight only when its payout crosses a bridge of three independent signers: reward shards must each be countersigned by a different established peer, so clones cannot collect without recruiting an ocean of honest sponsors. Behind the bridge sits a ferrous-hard bond, slashed on any detected duplicate, with penalties growing per offense. A hundred puppets need three hundred live foreign signatures every epoch, while one honest agent reuses its own three signers all year; the farm pays coordination for every clone, every cycle.
